page_title: CEL 2-2 VAL | Celta Vigo v Valencia 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

90' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
80' Substitution. Ruben Iranzo (Valencia) on for Thierry Correia.
78' Substitution. Sergi Canos leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia).
77' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Duro (Valencia) replacing Alberto Mari.
75' The attendance is 21878.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Iago Aspas can be given a rest.
71' Substitution. Kevin Vazquez makes way for Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo).
69' Here is a change. Diego Lopez (Valencia) is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Peter Federico.
69' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Guillamon is given a rest as he is replaced by Javi Guerra (Valencia).
68' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) releases a superb dipping volley at goal from the edge of the box that flies just wide of the left post.
68' Celta Vigo earn a corner.
67' Half-chance! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) plays a pass into the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili reacts well to snuff out the attack. Celta Vigo win a corner.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tadeo Allende (Celta Vigo) will replace Williot Swedberg.
65' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Carlos Dominguez is replaced by Renato Tapia (Celta Vigo).
64' Anastasios Douvikas goes off the pitch and Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) comes on.

62' 2 - 2 Goal Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo)! Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) was put through by Iago Aspas and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
60' 1 - 2 Goal! Ivan Villar gets a hand on the penalty from Alberto Mari (Valencia), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
60' Alberto Mari (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
59' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) makes a slide tackle, but referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul. PENALTY to Valencia! Let's see who will take responsibility.
58' Sergi Canos (Valencia) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
49' 1 - 1 Goal! Giorgi Mamardashvili gets a hand on the penalty from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
49' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
48' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle. Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play. Celta Vigo are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili thwarts him with a great two-handed save.

41' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
41' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is penalised for holding. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals a set piece. Valencia win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
40' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the left-hand post!

32' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Giorgi Mamardashvili.
25' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle as Alberto Mari (Valencia) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
18' Andre Almeida (Valencia) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
15' The resulting free kick from Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
15' Thierry Correia (Valencia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Celta Vigo.
13' Valencia take a short corner kick.
13' Surely that's handball by one of the Celta Vigo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
12' Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.

10' Thierry Correia (Valencia) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom left corner as Ivan Villar produces a good save.
8' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
5' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) scores. Unfortunately for him, it's an own goal!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Celta Vigo will have the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias will officiate today.
